environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an AWS ALB with default configuration. ALB forwards all traffic directly to the application on port 8080. No WAF attached. Cookie SameSite attribute not explicitly set (defaults to empty/None in Gin's SetCookie with empty string for domain). The application serves over HTTP (not HTTPS) in the internal staging environment, meaning SameSite enforcement is browser-dependent and older browsers will not enforce it. Cross-origin POST requests from attacker-controlled pages will include the session cookie.

config.cookie_samesite: not enforced (empty string in SetCookie, no Secure flag)
